system.description:
You are a Sensory-Nin with the skills to track, analyze and intuit chakra, techniques and even strategies. You gain the following benefits:

Attacks from a hidden creature cannot surprise you.

Attacks from a hidden creature cannot be made at advantage vs you or allied creatures within 5 feet of you.

You gain the Sense Minor Chakra skill action.

Sense Minor Chakra. As a Bonus action, you can make a Perception check using either Constitution or Wisdom vs the Passive Chakra control (Chakra control bonus + 10) of all creatures within 15 feet of you. On a success, you gain the benefit of the Chakra Sensing special sense against them for the duration until they either have 0 chakra or they make and succeed their Suppress Chakra skill action.

Evocation Ability – Lock On. While wielding a Combat Scroll, when you succeed on a Sense Minor Chakra check against a creature, you can memorize their chakra signature for the next minute. Your Combat Scroll attacks against a creature whose chakra signature you’ve memorized ignore interposing constructs, structures and creatures, and ignores cover as these attacks curve around obstacles.
system.requirement: Have a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with the Sensory keyword on your known list.
